title: Can't import using ufbx this specific fbx file I made in Milkshape 3D
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.3 stable

### System information

Windows 10 - Godot 4.3 stable - Compatibility - Nvidia GeForce GTX 1050

### Issue description

Can't import using ufbx this specific fbx file I made in Milkshape 3D. 
- In project settings FBX2gltf is disabled. 
- In File System tab I see red cross icon near the imported file.
- In Godot output tab I see errors:
```
  ufbx v0.14.0 error: Failed to load
  
  modules/fbx/fbx_document.cpp:2258 - Condition "err != OK" is true. Returning: err
  Error importing 'res://assets/models/max_payne/FBX/max_payne.fbx'.
  Signal 'tree_exiting' is already connected to given callable 'Node3DEditorViewport::_preview_exited_scene' in that object.
```
- In Godot console I see errors:
```
ERROR: ufbx v0.14.0 error: Failed to load

   at: (modules/fbx/fbx_document.cpp:2082)
ERROR: Condition "err != OK" is true. Returning: err
   at: append_from_file (modules/fbx/fbx_document.cpp:2258)
ERROR: Error importing 'res://assets/models/max_payne/FBX/max_payne.fbx'.
   at: (editor/editor_file_system.cpp:2607)
ERROR: Signal 'tree_exiting' is already connected to given callable 'Node3DEditorViewport::_preview_exited_scene' in that object.
   at: (core/object/object.cpp:1402)
```
- Blender cannot import this file either, saying `file version is 6000 which is not supported, use version 7100 or later`. Tried on Blender version 3.6 and 4.1.

### Steps to reproduce

Drag and drop the file into FileSystem tab. 

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

The fbx model in question: [max_payne.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18445180/max_payne.zip)
